name: TUI for rowbly skills
description:
- Currently we have CLI commands to list, install and create custom rowbly skills.
- This should be expanded so we also support this in the TUI
- Should be accessable via settings. Allows installation, creation, update and deletion of skills.

comments.author: sunny
comments.body: Scope clarification needed before implementation: what should updating official and custom skills do? Existing services support list, install and create only.

comments.author: sunny
comments.body:
Answers to FACTORY-QUESTIONS ROW-39 (from the user):

1. **Update** does both: for an official skill, reinstall the bundled version over the installed copy; for a custom skill, refresh its bundled Rowbly reference page and keep its `SKILL.md` instructions unchanged. No in-TUI editing of `SKILL.md`.
2. **Delete** removes only Rowbly skills: official Rowbly skills and custom skills that hold the Rowbly reference. Never other skill folders. Ask for confirmation in a modal first.

comments.author: sunny
comments.body: Draft PR: https://github.com/sgolovine/rowbly/pull/124. Added Settings → Skills for installation, creation, update and confirmed deletion through shared services. Official updates reinstall the bundled version; custom updates refresh only the Rowbly reference, preserving instructions. Deletion is restricted to Rowbly skills. Independent validation signed off e74140d: typecheck and lint passed, 77 unit and 20 CLI tests passed, manual workflows verified. Nine screenshots uploaded and verified. Worktree clean; CI pending.
